title: நிலச்சரிவு அபாய கண்காணிப்பு
landing_subtitle: AI-Powered Landslide Early Warning & Risk Monitoring
landing_desc: Monitor environmental conditions, analyze potential landslide risks, and visualize critical locations across the North Eastern Region of India with predictive intelligence.
log_in_console: Log in to the monitoring console
why_matters_h2: Why Landslide Monitoring Matters in NER
why_matters_desc: The North Eastern Region represents one of the most ecologically fragile and geologically active mountainous zones in the world.
torrential_desc: Extreme rainfall saturates fragile slopes within hours, triggering debris flows along highways and hill settlements.
steep_desc: High slope angles combined with weathered rock and soil layers create conditions primed for slope failure.
lives_desc: Early detection protects communities, critical corridors like NH-10, and emergency response logistics across the region.
bhusentry_desc: BHUSENTRY is an AI-powered landslide early warning and risk monitoring system built for the North Eastern Region. It fuses rainfall, slope, soil moisture, and vegetation indicators with geospatial intelligence to surface risk before disaster strikes.
feature_1: Real-time station telemetry across 8 NER states
feature_2: GIS map with satellite, elevation, and heatmap layers
feature_3: AI risk scores with clear LOW to CRITICAL labels
feature_4: Alert workflow with SMS notification simulation
geo_intel_desc: Live GIS · Station coordinates · Hazard radii
key_capabilities_desc: Everything officers need to monitor, predict, and act on landslide risk across NER.
ai_tech_desc: From raw sensors to actionable early warning in four phases.
data_ingestion_desc: Rainfall, slope angle, soil moisture, NDVI, and station coordinates feed the monitoring pipeline.
ai_scoring_desc: Weighted model combines environmental factors into a 0.00–1.00 risk index for each location.
risk_class_desc: Zones are labeled LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, or CRITICAL with high-contrast badges — never color alone.
disaster_warning_desc: Bulletins reach district emergency cells for proactive road closures and community guidance.
cta_ready: Ready to Explore the BHUSENTRY Monitoring Console?
cta_desc: Explore live interactive GIS maps, predictive AI simulations, and active disaster alerts across the North Eastern Region.
signup_email_msg: Enter your email address. We will send a 6-digit verification code to set up your account.
